cases.name: etaf-sqlite-schema-rejects-unsafe-identifiers
cases.purpose: Identifiers are validated before they can reach SQL text.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-loads-and-filters-pages
cases.purpose: The source should implement ETAF Data's load capability.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-mutations-are-visible-to-data-controller
cases.purpose: Insert, update, and delete should share the Data source contract.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-declares-provider-identity
cases.purpose: Expose SQLite identity without depending on ETAF observer internals.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-v2-mutation-outcome-reports-commit
cases.purpose: The optional v2 capability reports a committed transaction and token.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-v2-mutation-outcome-reports-rollback
cases.purpose: A failed v2 mutation reports rollback and preserves the original error.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-v2-post-commit-signal-reports-unknown
cases.purpose: A signal after sqlite-commit must not claim the committed write rolled back.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-v2-close-after-commit-reports-unknown
cases.purpose: A close signal after commit is also external uncertainty.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-upsert-inserts-and-updates
cases.purpose: Upsert inserts or updates by primary key, reports the identity and changes, and does not duplicate the row.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-mutating-a-missing-row-signals
cases.purpose: Update and replace signal for a missing identity instead of silently reporting zero changes.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-exposes-primary-key-identity
cases.purpose: The source supplies the primary key as the Data Controller item identity without an explicit callback.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-mutate-batch-commits-atomically
cases.purpose: A batch commits every statement together and rolls back on a failure.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-source-supports-data-batch-reconciliation
cases.purpose: ETAF Data's batch API writes through SQLite and reloads the page once.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-initialize-adds-missing-nullable-columns
cases.purpose: An existing database gains a nullable descriptor column in place.

cases.name: etaf-sqlite-initialize-rejects-non-nullable-addition
cases.purpose: A missing declared non-nullable column refuses to be added silently.
